entities.name: Echoverse
aliases: alternate reality version of the Multiverse
entities.description: An alternate reality version of the Multiverse created by Jace Beleren, free of suffering but shaped by his biases and hungry to consume what it imitates.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The original reality that Jace sought to fix and that the Echoverse threatens to overwrite.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker, traumatized by the New Phyrexian Invasion, who creates the Echoverse and is killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The Multiverse Vraska, who kills Jace and so prevents the overlay of the Echoverse onto the Multiverse.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A character who takes Jace's role in the Echoverse and, receiving Jace's planeswalker spark, summons Emrakul.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi summoned from Innistrad's moon who consumes the Echoverse and severs it from the Multiverse.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers that assembles to fight one of its founding members, Jace.

entities.name: Echoverse Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Ajani who never forgave himself for his brother's death and became a vengeful red-aligned planeswalker.

entities.name: Echoverse Liliana Vess
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Liliana who saved her brother, never turned to necromancy, and is a white-aligned healer and headmaster of Hexhaven Academy.

entities.name: Echoverse Karn
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Karn made of gold who sacrificed his spark to create Mirrodin and lives there as its protector.

entities.name: Echoverse Akroma
entities.description: A living Echoverse Akroma created by Nivea, made of red mana, an avatar of Nivea's revenge.

entities.name: Echoverse Edgar Markov
entities.description: An Echoverse Edgar Markov who founded a pack of werewolves, was imprisoned in the Helvault by his grandson, and has escaped to rule Innistrad's werewolves.

entities.name: Echoverse Tamiyo
entities.description: An Echoverse Tamiyo who rules as Emperor of Kamigawa after a coup.

entities.name: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: An Echoverse Niv-Mizzet who became a spirit dragon after being slain by the nephilim and now rules the Orzhov Syndicate.

entities.name: Echoverse Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A calm cryomancer Consulate enforcer trained by her father.

entities.name: Echoverse Samut
entities.description: A tyrant of Naktamun who worships Razaketh, whose spark never ignited.

entities.name: Echoverse Gideon Jura
entities.description: A living, self-serving mercenary who defeated Heliod.

entities.name: Echoverse Garruk
entities.description: Garruk who willingly donned the Chain Veil to suppress his beastly nature.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An Echoverse angel associated with the moon who leads humans, angels and undead against Edgar Markov.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A being who conquered Amonkhet and rules as a god of ice in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A living demon who rules over the Cabal in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who does not exist in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The Echoverse's version of Strixhaven University on Arcavios with five allied-colored battle-magic colleges; Jace uses its magical energy to stabilize his creation.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose devastation traumatized Jace.

entities.name: Reality Fracture
entities.description: The clash in which the Echoverse is overlaid on the Multiverse and then severed.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A prison created to hold anything threatening humanity, used by Avacyn and since destroyed in the Echoverse.

events.summary: Traumatized by the New Phyrexian Invasion and his role as a compleated planeswalker, Jace undoes his compleation on Vryn.
events.quote: After undoing his compleation on Vryn

events.summary: Jace decides to fix the Multiverse by creating an alternative to it, free of suffering, and excises people and events he disliked.
events.quote: He excised people and events from the Echoverse's history as if they never existed.

events.summary: Jace uses the magical energy of Hexhaven Academy to stabilize his creation.
events.quote: Jace uses this place of abundant magical energy to stabilize his creation.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Josu Vess survives and Liliana Vess saves her brother and never becomes a necromancer.
events.quote: Because she was able to save her brother, Liliana Vess never turned to necromancy

events.summary: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet, slain by the nephilim, becomes a spirit dragon and takes sole rule of the Orzhov Syndicate.
events.quote: leaving himself as the sole ruler of the Syndicate

events.summary: Echoverse Tamiyo claims the throne of Kamigawa in a coup.
events.quote: having claimed the throne in a coup

events.summary: The Echoverse is revealed to be hungry, needing to consume everything it imitates and to be laid over the Multiverse to stabilize.
events.quote: To sustain itself, it needs to consume everything it imitates.

events.summary: The Gatewatch assembles to fight one of its founding members, Jace, to prevent the Multiverse from being overwritten.
events.quote: the Gatewatch assembles to fight one of its founding members

events.summary: Vraska kills Jace, preventing the Echoverse from overlaying the Multiverse, though both realities remain intertwined.
events.quote: After Jace is killed by Vraska, the overlay of the Echoverse onto the Multiverse is prevented

events.summary: Tam, receiving Jace's spark, summons Emrakul from Innistrad's moon; Emrakul consumes the Echoverse and severs it from the Multiverse.
events.quote: The Eldrazi travels to the Echoverse and consumes it, simultaneously severing it from the Multiverse.

relations.quote: created by the planeswalker Jace Beleren

relations.note: she kills him to stop the overlay
relations.quote: After Jace is killed by Vraska

relations.note: consumes it and severs it from the Multiverse
relations.quote: The Eldrazi travels to the Echoverse and consumes it

relations.quote: His role is taken by Tam on Arcavios.
